title: MowBite OS app interface
description: robot_state, events and RPC methods of MowBite OS over MQTT, as system.api gives them. x-reasons has severity and resume of every reason by event (COMMAND_REFUSED only in refusals), x-emergency-bits the bits of emergency, x-commands the methods with params, result, the event of their refusal and the actions that do the same.

robot_state.description: robot_state/json, retained: the state of the mower for the app

battery_percentage.description: Charge of the battery from 0 to 1

gps_percentage.description: Quality of the position from 0 to 1, 0 without a recent pose or heading

current_action_progress.description: Always 0, kept for the app of OpenMower

current_state.description: State of the logic: IDLE, MOWING, DOCKING, UNDOCKING, AREA_RECORDING and the like

current_sub_state.description: What the state does right now, empty for nothing in particular

current_area.description: While mowing the index of the area in the plan, otherwise -1

current_path.description: While mowing the index of the path in the plan of the area, otherwise -1

current_path_index.description: While mowing the index of the pose in the path, otherwise -1

emergency.description: 1 while an emergency stops motion and blade

emergency_reason.description: The bits of the emergency (x-emergency-bits), 0 without one

is_charging.description: 1 while the mower charges on the docking station

rain_detected.description: 1 while the rain sensor reports rain

mowing.start.description: Starts or continues the job of mowing from IDLE

mowing.continue.description: Continues mowing after a pause that waits for the user

recording.discard.description: Drops what was recorded and not saved

recording.dock.description: Records a point of the docking station: first in front of it, then on the contacts; DOCK_RECORDED follows

recording.auto_points.description: Switches the automatic points of the ring on or off

recording.point.description: Takes the next position as a point of the ring
